Choose Your Device: Decide which device suits your skincare needs. For example, our LED masks are great for anti-aging and skin rejuvenation.
Set Up Your Device:
Fully charge the device before first use.
Attach any straps if required (we have video guides for this if needed).
Perform a Sensitivity Test:
Place the device on your inner arm and run a full 10-minute treatment.
Wait 6 hours to check for any redness or irritation. If none, you're good to go!
Prepare Your Skin:
Cleanse and dry your face thoroughly.
Avoid applying skincare products before using the device, as they may block light penetration.
